pages.title: A Step Aboard
pages.text: Operate a native train sliding access part and climb a Grab Bar or Bogie Step.

pages.title: A Step Aboard
pages.text: Make boarding and access practical; platforms and headlights finish the functional station.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Install windows, steps or slides on train/station; grab bars and bogie steps provide ladder-like access. Platforms frame the edge and crossing parts belong beside tracks.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a compatible track with a slab. Form a grade crossing, including on supported slopes and turns.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place an Andesite, Brass or Copper Grab Bar and climb it. Use a ladder-like block that the author also supports on trains.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Attach Bogie Steps to the carriage. Provide a ladder-like step extending below its placement block.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Place crossing gates and arm extenders beside a railway. Add the author's functional crossing components to the rail build.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Install train steps, slides or sliding windows. Add interactive access components to a train or station.
